decisions.reason: Product A has a dedicated page, indicating strong market focus and core utility, so it should be kept.
Building digital twin services align with growing demand in Germany, so despite limited promotion, the firm should keep it for now.
Authentication and identity delegation overlaps with the GIS-specific identity service (E) and lacks promotional visibility, making it redundant.
The open GIS framework has low commercial traction and only a brief website mention, so dropping it frees resources for more profitable products.
Product E has a clear launch announcement and value proposition for GIS applications, so it is likely to be retained.
